title: Happy frog
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='32' ry='24' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#A5D6A7'/>
  <!-- Left eye dome -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='44' r='13' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Right eye dome -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='44' r='13' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Left eye white -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='44' r='9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye white -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='44' r='9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Left pupil -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='43' r='5' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Right pupil -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='43' r='5' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Left eye shine -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='41' r='2' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- Right eye shine -->
  <circle cx='65' cy='41' r='2' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M 34 62 Q 50 80 66 62' stroke='#1B5E20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left cheek -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='60' r='4' fill='#EF9A9A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Right cheek -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='60' r='4' fill='#EF9A9A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Left front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='84' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Right front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='84' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Left back foot -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='90' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- Right back foot -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='90' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#2E7D32'/>
</svg>
